description: A merged PR introducing durable business knowledge: external identifiers accepted as a reconciliation key.

pullRequest.title: Allow payment reconciliation using external identifier
pullRequest.body: Reconciliation can now match a payment by its external broker identifier when the internal payment id is missing. This is a deliberate domain change requested by finance to reduce the unmatched backlog.
pullRequest.author: dev-bruno

commits.message: Accept external identifier as a reconciliation key
